title: FUNC01: unsaved condition overwritten during a remote message-only edit
evidence_medium: Direct screenshots only. These stills do not prove continuous foreground video.

finding_context.scope: Unsaved condition draft is replaced during a remote message-only save.
finding_context.chronology_basis: Recorder confirmed repeated reproductions around 13:01 UTC and 13:02:52 UTC. In the second reproduction, tab B had an unsaved quantity == 3 draft. Tab A saved only the message from TAB_A2 to TAB_A3, and tab B rendered the stored quantity == 4 with Apply disabled.
finding_context.screenshot_evidence_basis: Before 134 and after 135 are read from rendered pixels. The brief stale accessibility value is not used as image evidence.
finding_context.stored_condition_scope: Stored condition remained quantity == 4. No capture corruption or concurrent saved-write corruption is claimed.
finding_context.causality_and_warning_limit: Action chronology and absence of a warning over the sequence come from recorder observations; still screenshots alone do not establish them.

original_source_footer_note: All four originals display UI version 35.143306223. The established safe crop omits the footer; the version is recorded here as source metadata, not inserted into the pixels.
